description: NIX-517: packages whose npm install scripts may run when the AI CLIs are installed. One list for the Home Manager activation (ai-clis-npm.nix) and `just update-ai-clis`; tests/test_codex_doctor.py fails if either stops reading it. claude-code's postinstall replaces the bin/claude.exe placeholder with the native binary; grok's installs the binary into ~/.grok/bin.
